2027-01-05.title: Tuesday after the Second Sunday after Yaldo · Eve of Denho
readings: Grow up in every way into Christ
2027-01-05.alt: Season of Yaldo and Denho. Anniversary of the erection of the Eparchy of St Mary, Queen of Peace, USA–Canada (2016). Tomorrow is Denho: a day of obligation.
2027-01-05.verse: Consider the lilies, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not clothed like one of these.
theo: Paul says that the ascended Christ gave gifts to his Church, “some would be apostles, some prophets, some evangelists, some pastors and teachers, to equip the saints for the work of ministry, for building up the body of Christ.” The goal is maturity: “speaking the truth in love, we must grow up in every way into him who is the head, into Christ.” Each member has a part; when each works properly, the body grows in love.

In the Gospel Jesus tells his disciples not to worry about food or clothing: look at the ravens, consider the lilies. God feeds and clothes them; how much more will he care for you, “you of little faith”. Today we remember the erection of our Eparchy in the USA and Canada in 2016: thousands of our families live far from Kerala, often under great pressure of work and money. The word of Jesus is for them too: your Father knows what you need. On the eve of Denho, let us lay our worries before the Father who will speak tomorrow at the Jordan: “This is my beloved Son.”
outline: Ask: what worries are you carrying into the new year?
The Father knows what you need.
live: Name your biggest worry and entrust it to God in prayer tonight.
Call or message a relative or friend abroad and assure them of your prayers.
2027-01-05.prayer: Heavenly Father, you clothe the lilies and feed the ravens. Free us from anxious worry, help us grow into Christ by speaking the truth in love, and protect our families in every land, especially the faithful of our Eparchy in the USA and Canada. Amen.
altar: At every Qurbono the gifts of each member are gathered into one offering. Each of us has a place in the Body of Christ.

quick: Christ gives gifts to build up his Body.
We grow into Christ by speaking the truth in love.
Do not worry: the Father clothes the lilies.
2027-01-05.action: Entrust your biggest worry to God in prayer tonight.
2027-01-05.question: What worry keeps me from trusting God?

family.explain: Jesus said: look at the birds and the flowers. God feeds the birds and makes the flowers beautiful. He will take care of you too!
family.intention: We pray for our relatives working and studying in other countries.
family.ask: Ask: “What are you worried about? Let us give it to God together.”

illus: A Malankara family in Texas faced a job loss two months before their daughter's college fees were due. The mother pinned a small card on the fridge: Consider the lilies. The parish prayer group prayed with them weekly. A new job came, not quickly, but in time. The card is still on the fridge.

pm.open: Heavenly Father, you clothe the lilies and feed the birds. Take our worries as we gather, and help us to grow in Christ. Amen.
share: He gave gifts to build up the body of Christ (Ephesians 4:11–12). What is my gift for the Church?
Speaking the truth in love (Ephesians 4:15). Where do I need to speak the truth with love?
Consider the lilies (Luke 12:27). What worry can I give to God tonight?
interc: For our Church in the USA, Canada and every land of migration.
For pastors and teachers, that they may build up the body of Christ.
For those worried about jobs, debts or health.
For our group, that we may prepare our hearts for Denho.
pm.close: Father, you know what we need before we ask. Free us from worry, build us up as one body in Christ, and prepare us to hear your voice at the Jordan tomorrow. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, St Paul tells the Ephesians that the risen Christ gave gifts to his Church: apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors and teachers, to equip the saints for the work of ministry, for building up the body of Christ (Ephesians 4:11–12). Every gift is for others.
The goal is maturity: speaking the truth in love, we must grow up in every way into him who is the head, into Christ (Ephesians 4:15). Not truth without love, and not love without truth.

In the Gospel Jesus says: do not worry about your life, what you will eat, or about your body, what you will wear. Consider the ravens; consider the lilies. They neither toil nor spin, yet even Solomon in all his glory was not clothed like one of these (Luke 12:22, 27).

Today we remember the erection of our Eparchy of St Mary, Queen of Peace, in the USA and Canada. Many of our families live far from home under heavy pressure. Jesus says to them and to us: your Father knows what you need.
Tonight is the eve of Denho. Tomorrow the Father will speak at the Jordan: this is my beloved Son. Let us lay down our worries tonight and come tomorrow as children who trust their Father. Amen.
kids: Children, Jesus said: look at the flowers! God makes them so beautiful. If God takes care of flowers, he will surely take care of you. Don't be afraid!

intro: Gifts for the body, growth into Christ, freedom from worry.

q: The righteous flourish like the palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
But speaking the truth in love, we must grow up in every way into him who is the head, into Christ,

q: Cast your burden on the LORD, and he will sustain you; he will never permit the righteous to be moved.

points.apply: Entrust one worry to God tonight.

concl: The Father who clothes the lilies speaks tomorrow at the Jordan.
Come to Denho free of worry, ready to grow.
2027-01-05.resolve: Pray tonight for families in the diaspora.
